name: UkoreShot
description: Per-repo video library of Maya playblasts with a built-in player, plus the configurable Maya playblast tool itself (maya-scripts/UkorePlayblast/, merged in 2026-08-20 — previously the separate ukore_playblast plugin). Frame-by-frame drawing/comment review opens in this plugin's own in-house CommentEditor. Standalone — no Discord integration.
